protected_examples_paraglide_page_descri: Switch between languages to see the content update dynamically
protected_examples_paraglide_demo_descri: This message is dynamically loaded based on the selected language. The translations are managed through Paraglide.js and the Inlang ecosystem.
protected_examples_paraglide_how_it_work: Messages are stored in JSON files in the /messages directory
Paraglide compiles these at build time for optimal performance
Language detection uses first successful strategy: localStorage → URL → browser preference → base locale (en)
Switching languages saves the preference to localStorage and triggers a page reload (URL remains unchanged when using localStorage)
